column3: Calm down, Manami. You're acting weird today.
It's just, my heart is going "badum badum" and I just feel so, "Howwaan"...
M-My cheeks, my tummy, my head... They feel so tense and hot..
Like I said, if you keep using weird words, people will get the wrong idea!
It's... N-Not something perverted or weird. Err... Hm... Buuuh...
Aaanyway! Time to go home. Yup yup, it's decided, let's go.
Ah, Hm... Yes. But... a bit longer... Just a bit longer.
I want to stay with you... Just a bit longer.
Pure and proper high schoolers do not use those words!
Well, like I said! You can't use stuff like "in heat" in public! Also, saying "I want to stay with you", you know, it's...
Why am I getting so desperate about this?
Japanese sure is hard, huh, Kyou-chan.
Mmmm, I don't know how to say it another way... I might really be a bit weird...
H-H-H-Hey! What does she mean by that?!
Yup, I really am a bit twisted. Hehehe...
I want to stay with you... I-In what way..?
I'm an IDIOT! "In what way", there's only one way that can be interpreted?!
Ma-Manami-san? Why are you staring at those lovebirds?
You, you don't want to... with me...?
WHOOAAAA!  D-D-D-Don't "want t-"... w-what might that be..?
My dad would never forgive me!
That's right! That kind of thing is FORBIDDEN! Right now, I'm getting possessed by the spirit of my father!! HMRR! I can't, I CAN'T!
What the heck are you even saying?
Tch, c-could it really be that? Did she get all worked up because of those lovebirds?
Listen, Manami. You're acting real strange today.
Uhhh... Sorry... I lost my balance for a moment...
No, I'm fine. What about you?
